<L>1<pc>001<k1>a<k2>a
{#a#}¦
The first letter of the alphabet, and inherent short vowel.
<LEND>
<L>2<pc>001<k1>a<k2>a
{#a#}¦
<lex>ind.</lex>
.²1 No, not.
.²2 A privative, prohibitive, and diminutive particle.
.²3 An interjection of pity. It also implies degrees of difference, and similarity.
<div n="p">As a negative prefix to words beginning with a vowel, {#a#} is changed to {#an#}, as {#a#} and {#anta#} form {#ananta#}.

<L>223<pc>005<k1>agasti<k2>agasti
{#agasti#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-stiH#})
.²1 The name of a saint, celebrated in Hindu mythology, more usually entitled AGASTYA, the son of both MITRA and VARUṆA, by URVAŚĪ; he is represented of short stature, and is said by some to have been born in a water jar: he is famed for having swallowed the ocean, when it had given him offence; at his command also, the VINDHYA range of mountains prostrated itself, and so remains; hence his present appellation: he is also considered as the regent of the star Canopus.

.²3 The body.
.²4 An expedient, a means of success.
.²5 Mind, understanding.
.²6 A term in grammar, the inflective root, with the affix subjoined-
.²7 (<ab>Sing.</ab> only,) Chief, principal.
.²8 Inferior, secondary.
.²9 All [Page10] the {%dramatis personoe%} of a play, except the hero and heroine, the body of the characters.
.²10 (In rhetoric.) An incidental passion or figure, illustrative of, but subordinate to the main object of the description.
.²11 A scriptural work in the Jain religion; there are twelve works so named.
<lex>m.</lex> ({#NgaH#})

.²10 To, out to, (calling.)
.²11 Orderly, methodical.

<L>3704<pc>078<k1>avatAra<k2>avatAra
{#avatAra#}¦
<lex>n.</lex> ({#-raM#})
.²1 Descent, especially of a deity from heaven; the appearance of any deity upon earth, but more particularly the incarnations of VIṢṆU in ten principal forms which are well known, <ab>viz.</ab> .²1 The fish. .²2 The tortoise. .²3 The boar. .²4 The man-lion. .²5 The dwarf. .²6 and .²7 The two RĀMAS. .²8 KṚṢṆA. .²9 BUDDHA. And .²10 KALKI. A pious or distinguished person, in the language of respect or flattery, is also called an {%Avatāra%}, a descent or incarnation of the deity.
.²2 A {%Tīrtha%} or sacred place.
.²3 Translation, translating.
.²3 Descent.
.²4 Crossing.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#ava#} before, {#tF#} to cross, affix {#GaY#}.

<L>4915<pc>102<k1>A<k2>A, AN
{#A#} or {#AN#}¦
A particle, and prefix to words, implying;
.²1 Diminution, (a little.)
.²2 Limit, inceptive, (from, from thence, or that time.)
.²3 Limit conclusive, (until, unto, as far as.)
.²4 Prefixed to verbs it extends or reverses their meaning, as {#ruha#} to rise, {#Aruha#} to ascend, to mount, and {#gama#} to go, {#Agama#} to come.
.²5 In composition with nouns it forms indeclinables, either crude, as {#AjAnu#} to the knee, or with the terminations of the objective or ablative case, as {#AsamudraM#} or {#AsamadrAt#} as far as to the ocean.
.²6 A particle of menace or of pain, (ah! alas!) this is more correctly written {#As#}.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#Ap#} to pervade, to obtain, and {#qANa#} affix, {#pa#} is dropped.
<LEND>

<div n="p">In the first sense it is usually employed with {#vi#} prefixed, and in the second with {#ava#} or {#pra#};
<div n="p">also with {#aBi#} and{#vi#} prefixed,
to spread from one place to another;
<div n="p">with {#pari#} and {#vi#} or {#saM#} and {#vi#},
to obtain completely;
<div n="p">with {#saM#} and {#pra#},
to meet with, light upon or fall into;
<div n="p">with {#upa, saM#} and {#pra#},
to arrive at, to enter.
<LEND>

.²1 The supreme ruler of the universe, GOD; it is therefore applied to all the different divinities, but mostly designates ŚIVA, in mythological and popular acceptation. According to the {%Sāṃkhyas%}, {%Īśvara%} is the liberated spirit; finite, according to KAPILA; in finite, according to PATAÑJALI. In the {%Nyāya%} system, {%Īśvara%} is also a finite spirit endowed with attributes. In the {%Vedānta, Īśvara%} is infinite and universal spirit, [Page136] the cause and substance of creation.
.²2 A name of ŚIVA, especially in a compound, when the form of the deity implied is a {%Liṅga%}, as, {%Viśveśvara, Someśvara, Rāmeśvara%}, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²3 KĀMADEVA.
<lex>mfn.</lex> ({#-raH-rA-rI-raM#})
.²1 An owner, a proprietor, a chief or head.
.²2 Able, competent.
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-rA#} or {#-rI#})
.²1 A name of DURGĀ.
.²2 Of LAKṢMĪ, or of any other of the {%Śaktis%} or female energies of the deities.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#ISa#} to rule, and {#varaw#} or {#varac#} affix, consequently {#NIp#} or {#wAp#} for the feminine.

{#kara#} the hand, and {#toya#} water: at the wedding of ŚIVA and PĀRVATĪ, the water which had been poured into the hand of the former, constituted, upon its being thrown on the ground, the source of this river.

<L>9268<pc>195<k1>karRa<k2>karRa
{#karRa#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-rRaH#})
.²1 The ear.
.²2 KARṆA a prince, sovereign of {%Aṅgadeśa%}, and elder brother, by the mother's side, to the {%Pāṇḍu%} princes, being the son of SŪRYA by KUNTĪ, before her marriage with PĀṆḌU.
.²3 The helm or rudder of a vessel.
.²4 (In prosody,) A spondee, a foot of two long syllables.
.²5 (In geometry,) The hypothenuse of a triangle, or the diagonal of a tetragon.
.²6 A plant, (<bot>Cassia fistula</bot>.)
.²7 A kind of swallow wort, (<bot>Colotropis gigantea</bot>.)

<L>9406<pc>198<k1>karmman<k2>karmman
{#karmman#}¦
<lex>mn.</lex> ({#-rmmA-rmma#})
.²1 Action in general.
.²2 The object of an action.
.²3 The subject of action in grammar, considered of three kinds, {#prApya#} or {#vyApya#} when it is simple, as {#grAmaM gacCati#} he goes to the village; {#sUryyaM paSyati#} he sees the sun; {#vikAryya#} when change of form is implied, as {#suvarRaM {{kuMRqalaM->kuRqalaM||20161202|Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 303|}} karoti#} gold forms the ear-ring; and {#nirvartya#} when some new product is evolved, as {#kawaM karoti#} he makes a mat; {#putraM prasUte#} she bears a son.
.²4 The objective noun.
.²5 Action specific, moral duty, the obligation imposed by peculiarities of tribe, occupation, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²6 Natural, active property, as maturity, of heat; support, of earth; dispersion, of wind, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²7 Religious action, as sacrifice, ablution, <ab>&c.</ab> especially as originating in the hope of future recompense, and as opposed to speculative religion or knowledge of spirit.
.²8 (In Logic,) Substantial action or motion of five kinds, upwards, downwards, extension, contraction, and going in general.
.²9 Action or act involving retribution or reward, virtue, vice, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²10 Fate, the certain consequence of previous acts.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#kfY#} to do, {#manin#} <ab>aff.</ab>
<LEND>

<L>13622<pc>291<k1>guRa<k2>guRa
{#guRa#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-RaH#})
.²1 A quality, attribute, or property in general.
.²2 A property of all created things; three are particularized, the {%Sattva%}, {%Raja%}, and {%Tama%}, or principles of truth or existence, passion or foulness, and darkness or ignorance.
.²3 A means of defence, one of six expedients in government, as, peace, war, a march, a halt, a stratagem, and recourse to protection: see {#sanDi#}, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²4 Form, shape, <ab>&c.</ab> or property of the body.
.²5 Knowledge, ignorance, <ab>&c.</ab> or quality of the mind.
.²6 Heroism, valor, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²7 White, black, <ab>&c.</ab> or the attributes of color.
.²8 An organ of sense.
.²9 A string in general.
.²10 A bow-string.
.²11 Abandoning, leaving.
.²12 A cook.
.²13 A name of BHĪMA.
.²14 Secondary, subordinate.
.²15 Excellence, merit, freedom from fault or blemish.
.²16 (In arithmetic,) The given coefficient of any number.
.²17 (In geometry,) The chord of an are.
.²18 (In grammar,) The substitution of {%e, o, ar%} and {%al%} for {%i, u, ṛ%}, {%ḷ%}.
.²19 (In rhetoric,) Consistency of plan, elegance of expression, <ab>&c.</ab> as the merits of a composition.
.²20 In composition with numerals, multiplication, as {#dviguRa#} twice, {#triguRa#} thrice.
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-RA#})
A plant of the fibres of which bow-strings are made: see {#mUrvvA#}.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#guRa#} to address or advise, affix {#kta#}.

<L>16835<pc>361<k1>RI<k2>RI
{#RI#}¦
({#Ya#}) {#RIY#} <lex>r.</lex> 1st <ab>cl.</ab> ({#nayati-te#})
.²1 To conduct, to drive or guide, to cause progressive conveyance.
.²2 To obtain, to get.
The root is inflected as the deponent verb, implying.
.²1 {%Instruction%}, as {#nayate SAstre#} he instructs in the {%Śāstra%};
.²2 {%Worshipping%}, {#vizRuMnayate#} he worships VIṢṆU;
also with prepositions in the sense of;
.²1 {%Paying%}, {#Bftyamupanayate#} he pays the hire;
.²2 {%Paying as a debt%}, {#fRamvinayate#} he discharges the debt;
.²3 {%Casting or lifting up%}, {#daRqamunnayate#} he lifts up the stick;
.²4 {%Giving%}, {#dravyambinayate#} he gives the things; and
.²5 {%Brahmanical Investiture%}, {#puttramupanayate#} he invests his son with the thread:
<div n="p">it is also deponent, governing an incorporeal object existing in the agent, as
{#kroDamvinayate#}
he suppresses wrath;
<div n="p">if the object is not in the agent the verb is active, as
{#{{guroHktoDamvinayati->guroHkroDamvinayati||20161210|Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 306|ktoDam -> kroDam}}#}
he appeases his teacher's anger;
<div n="p">as also if the object is corporal,
as {#gaRqaM vinayati#} he turns away the cheek.
<div n="p">The root occurs with many prefixes, and in a great variety of meanings;
<div n="p">.²1 With {#anu#},
.²a To ask, to entreat. .²b To make like or resembling. .²c To favour.
<div n="p">.²2 With {#apa#},
.²a To take away, to remove. .²b To attract.
<div n="p">.²3 With {#aBi#},
.²a To indicate by signs. .²b To be kind or civil to.
<div n="p">.²4 With {#AN#},
To bring.
<div n="p">.²5 With {#ut#},
To raise up.
<div n="p">.²6 With {#upa#},
To approach, to go near to, (see also above.)
<div n="p">.²7 With {#dur#},
To act or behave wickedly.
<div n="p">.²8 With {#nir#},
.²a To get or obtain. .²b To ascertain, to determine.
<div n="p">.²9 With {#pari#},
.²a To marry. .²b To take cognizance of.
<div n="p">.²10 With {#pra#},
.²a To punish. .²b To love.
<div n="p">.²11 With {#vi#},
.²a To take away, to make remote or distant. .²b To be humble or modest.
<div n="p">.²12 With {#vi#} and {#apa#},
To remove, to dispel, to disperse.
<div n="p">.²13 With {#vi#} and {#nir#},
To decide by law.
<div n="p">.²14 With {#sam#},
.²a To collect. .²b To discharge.
<div n="p">.²15 With {#sam#} and {#anu#},
To intreat.
<div n="p">.²16 With {#sama#} and {#AN#},
To assemble, to collect, <ab>&c.</ab>

<L>16906<pc>363<k1>tattva<k2>tattva

<lex>n.</lex> ({#-ttvaM#})
.²1 Essential nature, the real nature of the human soul, considered as one and the same with the divine spirit animating the universe: the philosophical etymology of this word best explains its meaning, {#tad#} that, {%that divine%} {%being%}, and {#tva#} thou, that {%very God%} art {%thou%}.

.²3 Truth, reality, substance, opposed to what is illusory or fallacious.

.²5 A first principle, an axiom.
.²6 Mind, intellect.
.²7 Slow time in music.
.²8 A musical instrument.
<ab>E.</ab>
as above, or {#tada#} that, thence, <ab>&c.</ab> affix {#tva#}; the word is properly, therefore, written {#tattva#}, but in books one {#ta#} is commonly rejected.

<L>17001<pc>365<k1>tantra<k2>tantra
{#tantra#}¦
<lex>mfn.</lex> ({#ntraH-ntrA-ntraM#})
Dependant, subservient.
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-ntraH#})
A weaver.
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-ntrI#})
.²1 Any string or rope.
.²2 The wire or string of a lute.
.²3 Any tubular vessel of the body.
.²4 A plant, (<bot>Menispermum glabrum</bot>): see {#gUqucI#}.
.²5 The name of a river.
.²6 A young woman.
<lex>n.</lex> ({#-ntraM#})
.²1 A {%Tantra%}, a religious treatise teaching peculiar and mystical formulæ and rites for the worship of the deities, or the attainment of superhuman power: it is mostly in the form of a dialogue between ŚIVA and DURGĀ, who are the peculiar gods of the {%Tāntrikas%}: there is a great number of these works, and their authority, in many parts of {%India%}, seems to have, in a great measure, superseded that of the {%Vedas%}: according to one account, a {%Tantra%} comprises five subjects, the creation and destruction of the world, the worship of the gods, the attainment of all objects, magical rites for the acquirement of six (superhuman) faculties, and four modes of union with spirit by meditation; a variety of subjects are, however, introduced into many of them, whilst some are limited to a single topic, as the mode of breathing in certain rites, the language of birds, beasts, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²2 A branch of the {%Vedas%}, that which teaches {%Mantras%} or mystical and magical formula.
.²3 Demonstration, clear and right conclusion.
.²4 Raiment, vesture.
.²5 A medicament, a drug.
.²6 A principal medicament, or perhaps a {%charm%}, considered as producing medicinal effects.
.²7 Providing for a family.
.²8 A cause, a motive.
.²9 Cause common to two or more results; the instruments or means of more than one effect.
.²10 Necessary or indispensable act or provision; the right way of doing any thing.
.²11 Chief, principal.
.²12 A royal retinue, a court, a train.
.²13 An army.
.²14 A royal property; that of providing for the security and prosperity of the kingdom.
.²15 A realm, a country.
.²16 A thread.
.²17 Subservience, service, dependance.
.²18 Oath or ordeal.
.²19 Decorations, hanging with trophies, garlands, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²20 Heap, multitude.
.²21 Wealth.
.²22 A house.
.²23 An implement of weaving, a loom.
.²24 Happiness, felicity.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#tana#} to spread or extend, affix {#zwran#}; or {#tatri#} to spread, to support a family, <ab>&c.</ab> affix {#ka#}, <ab>fem.</ab> affix {#NIp#}; or {#tattra#} with {#I#} Uṇādi <ab>aff.</ab>
<LEND>

<L>17020<pc>365<k1>tapa<k2>tapa
{#tapa#}¦
({#O#}) {#tapO#} <lex>r.</lex> 1st <ab>cl.</ab> ({#tapati-te#}) <lex>r.</lex> 4th <ab>cl.</ab> ({#tapyati-te#}) and <lex>r.</lex> 10th <ab>cl.</ab> [Page366] ({#tApayati-te#})
.²1 To heat or be hot, to burn; (hence figuratively,) to suffer mental or bodily pain.
.²2 To have pre-eminent or superhuman power:
<div n="p">the deponent form only is used when the root with the prefix {#ut#} or {#vi#} occurs intransitively, or governs as its object part of the body of the agent, as {#pARiM vitapate#} warms the hand, ({#uttapate vitapate#}) shines, burns, <ab>&c.</ab> The root takes the passive form also, when implying religious meditation, as {#tapyate tapastApasaH#} the devotee revolves religious thoughts.
<div n="p">With {#anu#} prefixed,
({#anutapate#})
To repent, to regret.
<div n="p">With {#pari#} or {#sam#}
({#paritapati santapati#},)
.²1 To bear or inflict pain, anguish, heat, distress, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²2 To be sorrowful, to repent.
<LEND>

<L>18327<pc>394<k1>dakza<k2>dakza
{#dakza#}¦
<lex>mfn.</lex> ({#-kzaH-kzA-kzaM#})
Clever, able, dexterous.
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-kzaH#})
.²1 A {%Brahmādika%}; according to one legend, son of BRAHMĀ, born from the thumb of his right hand, for the purpose of peopling the world: according to another, he is the son of the {%Munis%}, called {%Prācetasas%}. DAKṢA had sixty daughters, of whom twenty-seven are the nymphs who form the lunar asterisms, and wives of the moon; one of his daughters also was SATI or DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA; and seventeen were married to KAŚYAPA, and were the mothers of all created beings. DAKṢA was on one occasion decapitated by ŚIVA: see {#dakzADvaraDvaMsakft#}; he is sometimes regarded as an {%Avatāra%} of BRAHMĀ himself. [Page395]
.²2 A {%Muni%} and legislator, who flourished in the beginning of the {%Tretā%} {%Yuga%}.
.²3 A kind of tree.
.²4 The bull of ŚIVA.
.²5 A cock.
.²6 A scholar, a {%Paṇḍita%}.
.²7 A dexterous or clever man.
.²8 ŚIVA.
.²9 A name of {%Agni%} of fire.
.²10 A general lover, one attached to many mistresses.
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-kzA#})
The earth.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#dakza#} to grow or increase, affix {#ac#}.
<LEND>

<L>18335<pc>395<k1>dakzADvaraDvaMsakft<k2>dakzADvaraDvaMsakft
{#dakzADvaraDvaMsakft#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-kft#})
A name of ŚIVA.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#dakza#} the {%Brahmādika%}, as DAKṢA, {#aDvara#} a sacrifice, {#DvaMsakft#} subduer or disturber: DAKṢA having on one occasion made a sacrifice, to which he invited all the gods, except his son-in law ŚIVA, and his wife SATI, the latter went unbid, and being received coolly, threw herself into the fire; an emanation of ŚIVA, proceeded against DAKṢA, and an affray ensued, in which the gods and {%Ṛṣis%} were maltreated and dispersed, and DAKṢA decapitated; he was restored to life, and the head of a ram substituted for the one he had lost.

<L>19579<pc>421<k1>deva<k2>deva
{#deva#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-vaH#})
.²1 A deity, a god.
.²2 A king, in poetical language.
.²3 A husband's brother: see {#devf#}.
.²4 A cloud.
.²5 A fool, a dolt.
.²6 A child.
.²7 A man following any particular line or business.
.²8 A spear-man, a lancer.
.²9 Emulation, wish to excel or overcome.
.²10 Sport, play.
.²11 A term or surname applicable to a {%Brahman%}; also to a man of the {%Kayeth%} class.
<lex>n.</lex> ({#-vaM#})
An organ of sense.
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-vA#})
.²1 A flower, (<bot>Hibiscus mutabilis</bot>).
.²2 A plant, (<bot>Marsilea quadrifolia</bot>.)
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-vI#})
.²1 A goddess, the wife of any deity or divine being.
.²2 A name very commonly applied to the goddess DURGĀ.
.²3 A queen, one who has been consecrated as well as the king, (in theatrical language chiefly.)
.²4 A respectful epithet or title applied to a woman of the first class.
.²5 Worship, reverence.
.²6 A plant, (<bot>Trigonella corniculata</bot>.)
.²7 Another plant: see {#mUrvvA#}.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#diva#} to play, (in heaven, <ab>&c.</ab>) affix {#ac#}, <ab>fem.</ab> affix {#wAp#} and {#NIz#}.
<LEND>

<L>23013<pc>497<k1>pata<k2>pata
{#pata#}¦
({#x#}) {#patx#} <lex>r.</lex> 1st <ab>cl.</ab> ({#patati#}) <lex>r.</lex> 10th <ab>cl.</ab> ({#patayati#} or {#pAtayati#})
.²1 To go, to move, but especially downwards; as, to fall, to descend, to alight.
.²2 To possess supreme or superhuman power.
<lex>r.</lex> 4th <ab>cl.</ab> ({#patyate#})
To be rich or powerful.
<div n="p">With {#ati#} prefixed,
To excel or surpass.
<div n="p">With {#aBi#} or {#ava#},
To descend.
<div n="p">With {#AN#},
To arrive, to come.
<div n="p">With {#ut#},
To ascend.
<div n="p">With {#ni#},
To gain or get.
.²2 To happen.
<div n="p">With {#nir#},
To abscond.
<div n="p">With {#pari#},
.²1 To go fast.
.²3 To be valuable.
<div n="p">With {#pra#} and {#ni#},
To fall prostrate, to salute, to worship.
<div n="p">With {#vi#} and {#nir#},
To turn, to turn back.
<div n="p">With {#sam#},
.²1 To go with.
.²2 To gain.
<div n="p">With {#sam#} and {#AN#},
To purify or cleanse.
<div n="p">With {#sam#} and {#ut#},
To fly.
<div n="p">With {#sam#} and {#ni#},
To go forth or out.
<LEND>

<L>25100<pc>543<k1>purARa<k2>purARa
{#purARa#}¦
<lex>n.</lex> ({#-RaM#})
A {%Purāṇa%} or sacred and poetical work, supposed to be compiled or composed by the poet VYĀSA; and comprising the whole body of {%Hindu%} theology: each {%Purāṇa%} should treat of five topics especially; the creation, the destruction, and renovation of worlds; the genealogy of gods and heroes; the reigns of the {%Menus%}, and the transactions of their descendants: but great variety prevails in this respect, and few contain historical or genealogical matter. There are eighteen acknowledged {%Purāṇas%}.
.²1 BRĀHMA.
.²2 {%Pādma%}, or the lotus.
.²3 {%Brahmāṇḍa%}, or the egg of BRAHMA.
.²4 {%Āgneya%}, or {%Agni%} fire.
.²5 VAIṢṆAVA, or of VIṢṆU.
.²6 {%Garuḍa%}.

.²18 The {%Bhāgavata%}, or life of KṚṢṆA, which last is by some considered as a spurious and modern work: the {%Brahmavaivarta%} is also of very modern origin. The {%Purāṇas%} are reckoned to contain four hundred thousand stanzas: there are also eighteen {%Upapurāṇas%} or similar poems of inferior sanctity, and different appellations; the whole constitute the popular or poetical creed of the {%Hindus%}, and some of them or particular parts of them, are very generally read, and studied.

<L>25750<pc>557<k1>prakfti<k2>prakfti
{#prakfti#}¦
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-tiH#})
.²1 Nature; in philosophy, the passive or material cause of the world, as opposed to the active or spiritual; and in mythology, a goddess, the personified will of the Supreme in the creation, identified with {%Māyā%} or illusion, and in an especial manner the prototype of the female sex; hence it is the same with the {%Śakti%} or personified energy or bride of a deity, as LAKṢMĪ, DURGĀ, <ab>&c.</ab> in some systems {%Prakṛti%} is considered the same with the Supreme Being.
.²2 The natural state or condition of any thing.
.²3 A radical form or predicament of being, as illusion, intelligence, consciousness, and the five elements, or {%Ākāśa%}, fire, air, earth, and water.
.²4 The five elements collectively.
.²5 Cause, origin.
.²6 A woman or womankind.
.²7 A mother.
.²8 An animal.
.²9 The male organ of generation.
.²10 The female organ of generation.
.²11 An uninflected word; the radical form of a word, before the affixes forming cases, <ab>&c.</ab> are subjoined.
.²12 A requisite of regal administration, of which seven are enumerated; the king, the minister, an ally, treasure, territory, fortresses, and an army: the corporations or companies of citizens are sometimes added, making an eighth class.
.²13 A form of metre, consisting of a stanza of four lines, each line containing twenty-one syllables.

<L>26586<pc>576<k1>prayAga<k2>prayAga
{#prayAga#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-gaH#})
.²1 Sacrifice, oblation.
.²2 A celebrated place of pilgrimage, the confluence of the {%Ganges%} and {%Jumna%}, with the supposed subterraneous addition of the {%Sarasvatī%}; the modern {%Allahabad%}. The term in composition is applied to many places of reputed sanctity, situated at the confluence of two rivers, as {%Deva-Prayāga%}, {%Rudra-Prayāga, Karṇa-Prayāga%}, and {%Nanda-Prayāga%}, in the {%Himāla%} mountains, which with {%Prayoga%} or {%Allahabad%}, constitute the five principal places so termed.
.²3 A name of INDRA.
.²4 A horse.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#pra#} principal, {#yaja#} to worship, and {#GaY#} <ab>aff.</ab>; actual worship, or the place where worship is peculiarly efficacious; {%Allahabad%} is one of the places where BRAHMĀ is supposed to have consummated ten {%Aśvamedhas%} or sacrifices of the horse, in commemoration of his recovery of the four {%Vedas%} from ŚAṄKHĀSURA.

<L>28199<pc>612<k1>Badra<k2>Badra
{#Badra#}¦
<lex>mfn.</lex> ({#-draH-drA-draM#})
.²1 Happy, prosperous, lucky, propitious.
.²2 Best, excellent.
.²3 Pure, pious, virtuous.
<lex>n.</lex> {%<lex>subst.</lex>%} ({#-draM#})
Prosperity, fortune, happiness.
(<lex>adv.</lex>)
Happy, well, right.
<lex>n.</lex> ({#-draM#})
.²1 A fragrant grass, (<bot>Cyperus</bot>.)
.²2 Gold.
.²3 Iron or steel.
<lex>nf.</lex> ({#-draM-drI#})
One of the astrological periods called {%Karaṇas%}, the seventh; also called {%Viṣṭī%}, regarded as an unlucky period.
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-draH#})
.²1 A name of ŚIVA.
.²2 A wagtail.
.²3 A bull.
.²4 A heap, a multitude.
.²5 A description of elephant, one of four classes into which they are divided.
.²6 Mount {%Meru%}.
.²7 One of the nine persons termed {%Śuklabalas%} by the {%Jainas%}.
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-drA#})
.²1 The Ganges of heaven.
.²2 The ichneumon plant: see {#rAsnA#}.
.²3 Indigo.
.²4 <bot>Asclepias pseudosarsa</bot>.
.²5 A shrub, (<bot>Pœderia foetida</bot>.)
.²6 A medicinal plant, commonly {%Kayaphal%}.
.²7 A name of the second, seventh, and twelfth days of the lunar fortnight.
.²8 A female {%Śakti%} or deity of the {%Jainas%}.
.²9 One of the four divisions of the Ganges, according to the {%Purāṇas%}, that which flows to the northern {%Kuru%}.
.²10 A tree, (<bot>Gmelina arborea</bot>.)
.²11 A cow.
.²12 Turmerick.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#Badi#} to be happy, Uṇādi <ab>aff.</ab> {#ran#} and the nasal rejected.
<LEND>

<lex>f.</lex> ({#-sA#})
One of the philosophical systems of the {%Hindus%}, or rather a two-fold system, the two parts of which form two of the six {%Darśanas%} or schools of philosophy; the first part, the {%Pūrva%} {%Mīmāṃsā%}, or {%Mīmāṃsā%} simply, originates with [Page663] the {%Muni%} JAIMINI, and illustrates the {%Karma kāṇḍa%} of the {%Vedas%}, or the practical part, (the ritual,) of religion and devotion, including also moral and legal obligations. The second part, or {%Uttara Mīmāṃsā%}, ascribed to VYĀSA, is the same as the {%Vedānta%}, founded on the {%Jñāna-kāṇḍa%} or theological portion of the {%Vedas%}, and treating of the spiritual worship of the Supreme Being or soul of the universe.

{#mAna#} to seek knowledge, <ab>aff.</ab> {#aN#} and {#wAp#}; the derivative takes the augment of the reduplicate form of the verb.

<L>30987<pc>674<k1>meru<k2>meru
{#meru#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-ruH#})
The sacred mountain {%Meru%}, in the centre of the seven continents, compared to the cup or seed-vessel of the lotus, the leaves of which are formed by the different {%Dvīpas%}: its height is said by the {%Hindus%} to be 84,000 {%Yojanas%}, sixteen thousand of which are below the surface of the earth: the shape is variously described, as square, conical, columnar, spherical, or spiral; and the four faces of it are of various colours, or white towards the east, yellow to the south, back to the west, and red towards the north: the river {%Ganges%} falls from heaven on its summit, and flows thence to the surrounding worlds in four streams; the southern branch is the {%Ganges%} of {%India%}, the northern running into {%Tartary%} is the {%Bhadrasomā%}, the eastern is the {%Sītā%}, and the western the {%Cakṣu%} or {%Oxus%}: on the summit of {%Meru%} BRAHMĀ resides, attended and worshipped by the {%Ṛṣis, Gandharbas%}, <ab>&c.</ab>; the regents of the points of the compass occupy the corresponding faces of the mountain, the whole of which consists of gold and gems: considered in any but a fabulous light, mount {%Meru%} appears to mean the high land of {%Tārtary%}, immediately to the north of the {%Himālaya%} mountains.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#mi#} to scatter, (radiance,) Uṇādi <ab>aff.</ab> {#ru#}.
<LEND>

<L>31164<pc>678<k1>yajus<k2>yajus
{#yajus#}¦
<lex>n.</lex> ({#-juH#})
The {%Yajur%} or {%Yajuṣ%}, one of the four {%Vedas%}; it is divided into two principal portions, the white and black, or {%Vājasaneyi%} and {%Taittirīya%}, the former of which is attributed to the saint YĀJÑAVALKYA, to whom it was revealed by the sun, in the form of a horse; and the latter to TITTIRI, to whom it was communicated by YĀSKA, the first pupil of its original author, the sage VAIŚAMPĀYANA: according to the {%Purāṇas%}, the {%Taittirīya%} portion was named from {%Tittiri%} a partridge; the disciples of VAIŚAMPĀYANA being changed into those birds, to pick up the texts of the {%Veda%}, as they were disgorged in a tangible shape by YĀJÑAVALKYA, at the command of VAIŚAMPĀYANA: both portions of this {%Veda%} are very full on the subject of religious rites, and the prayers peculiar to it, are chiefly in measured and poetical prose.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#yaja#} to worship, Uṇādi <ab>aff.</ab> {#usi#}.
<LEND>

<L>31325<pc>682<k1>yavana<k2>yavana
{#yavana#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-naH#})
.²1 A country; probably {%Bactria%}, or it may be extended from that colony to {%Ionia%}, (to which word it bears some resemblance,) or still further to {%Greece%}: by late {%Hindu%} writers, it is most commonly applied to {%Arabia%}.
.²2 A {%Yavana%}, apparently originally a {%Greek%}, but since applied to both the {%Mohammedan%} and {%European%} invaders of {%India%}, and often used as a general term for any foreign or barbarous race.
.²3 Speed, velocity.
.²4 A swift horse.
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-nI#})
The wife of a {%Yavana%}.

<L>31556<pc>688<k1>yoga<k2>yoga
{#yoga#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-gaH#})
.²1 Junction, joining, union.
.²2 Combination, association, meeting, conflux.
.²3 Religious and abstract meditation.
.²4 Keeping the body in a fixed posture.
.²5 Devotion, spiritual worship of GOD, or union with the Supreme Being by means of abstract contemplation; this does not necessarily imply an abandonment of the world or relinquishment of the usual observances of religion, but it involves internal indifference to objects of pleasure and pain, and utter disregard of the consequences or fruit of ceremonial rites.
.²6 The particular practice of the preceding sort of devotion, or the exercise of that abstraction by which union with GOD is supposed to be obtained; in the {%Gītā%} it is described as sitting on {%Kuśa%} grass, with the body firm, the eyes fixed on the tip of the nose, and the mind intent on the Deity; in the {%Tantras%} a fanciful operation is prescribed, by which the vital spirit seated in the lower part of the body, and the etherial spirit placed in the head, are supposed to be brought into combination in the brain, when the devotee becomes united with BRAHMA.
.²7 The system of philosophy which treats of the union of the soul with BRAHMA or GOD; it is the same as the {%Pātañjali%} doctrine, and constitutes one of the six {%Darśanas%} or philosophical schools of the {%Hindus%}.
.²8 Magic, or the acquisition of supernatural powers by the mystical and magical worship of ŚIVA and DURGĀ especially.
.²9 Consequence, result, the main end or object of any thing or act.
.²10 Connexion of one thing with another, as of cause with effect, predicate with subject, quality with substance, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²11 Acquisition of something not possessed before, accession of property or wealth; in grammar this application is assigned to any unusual construction of words or compounds, unauthorised by rule, but sanctioned by the authority that employs them.
.²12 A rule, an aphorism.
.²13 Propriety, fitness.
.²14 Side, part, cause or argument to be maintained or defended.
.²15 Thing, substance.
.²16 Wealth.
.²17 A drug, a {{medicament, epecially->medicament, especially||20210731|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66|}} a compound of various ingredients.
.²18 Fraud, trick.
.²19 A logician.
.²20 A spy, an informer.
.²21 A violator of truth or confidence.
.²22 A conveyance, a carriage, a boat, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²23 A means, an expedient.
.²24 Armour.
.²25 Putting on armour.
.²26 Lucky conjuncture.
.²27 (In arithmetic,) Addition.
.²28 (In astronomy,) The leading or principal star of a lunar mansion.
.²29 The twenty-seventh part of 360° of a great circle measured on the plane of the ecliptic, and used in calculating the longitudes of the sun and moon; each {%Yogas%} has a distinct name; astrologers also enumerate twenty-eight {%Yogas%} differently named from the foregoing, and corresponding with the twenty-eight {%Nakṣatras%}, or the divisions of the moon's path, but varying according to the day of the week.
.²30 A period, or the time during which the sum of the motions of the sun and moon amount to one {%Nakṣatra%}, the mean duration of which is 23hs. 47' 44".
<ab>E.</ab>
{#yuja#} to join literally or figuratively, as with GOD, <ab>aff.</ab> {#GaY#}.
<LEND>

<L>31984<pc>697<k1>rasa<k2>rasa
{#rasa#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-saH#})
.²1 Flavour, taste, as sweet, salt, pungent, bitter, sour, and astringent.
.²2 Taste, sentiment, emotion, as an object of poetry or composition; eight sentiments are usually enumerated, {%Śṛṅgāra%} or love, {%Hāsya%} or mirth, {%Karuṇā%} or tenderness, {%Raudra%} or anger, {%Vīra%} or heroism, {%Bhayānaka%} or terror, {%Bībhatsa%} or disgust, and {%Adbhuta%} or surprise: {%Śānta%}, tranquillity or content, or {%Vātsalya%}, paternal tenderness, is sometimes considered as the ninth.
.²3 Affection of the mind, passion.
.²4 Juice, exudation, a fluid, a liquid, or liquified substance.
.²5 Poison.
.²6 Semen virile.
.²7 Water.
.²8 The primary or essential juice or fluid of the body, whence blood, serum, sweat, <ab>&c.</ab> are supposed to be engendered; it corresponds best with chyle, but is probably of a fanciful nature.
.²9 Gum myrrh.
.²10 Quicksilver, from its being a semi-fluid metal, and according to certain alchymical notions possessed of supernatural power over the juices of the body, <ab>&c.</ab>
.²11 A mineral or a metallic salt, as sulphur, borax, talc, blue or green vitriol, <ab>&c.</ab>; they are however usually called {%Upa%} or inferior {%Rasas%}.
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-sA#})
.²1 The earth.
.²2 The tongue.
.²3 A plant, commonly {%Aknadhi%}, (<bot>Cissampelos hexandra</bot>.)
.²4 A sort of grain, (<bot>Panicum italicum</bot>.)
.²5 The frankincense tree, (<bot>Boswellia thurifera</bot>.)
.²6 The grape.
.²7 A medical drug, commonly {%Kākoli%}.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#rasa#} to taste, to love, <ab>&c.</ab>, <ab>aff.</ab> {#ac#}.
<LEND>

<lex>m.</lex> ({#-rziH#})
A kind of saint; that holy and superhuman personage which a king or man of the military class may become by the practice of religious austerities; seven classes of {%Ṛṣis%} are enumerated, the {%Devarṣi, Brahmarṣi, Maharṣi, Paramarṣi, Rājarṣi, Kāṇḍarṣi%}, and {%Śrutarṣi%}: the order is variously given, but the {%Rājarṣi%} is inferior to the four preceding ones, and the two last mean the inspired saints and supposed authors of the {%Hindu%} scriptures.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#rAja#} king, and {#fzi#} a saint.

<L>33087<pc>723<k1>loka<k2>loka
{#loka#}¦
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-kaH#})
.²1 Man, mankind.
.²2 A world, a division of the universe; in general three {%Lokas%} are enumerated, or heaven, hell, and earth: another classification enumerates seven, exclusive of the infernal regions; or {%Bhūr-loka%} the earth, {%Bhuvar-loka%} the space between the earth and the sun, the region of the {%Munis, Siddhis%}, <ab>&c.</ab>; {%Svarloka%} the heaven of INDRA, between the sun and the polar star; {%Maharloka%} the usual abode of BHṚGU, and other saints, who are supposed to be co-existent with BRAHMĀ: during the conflagration of these lower worlds, the saints ascend to the next, or {%Janaloka%}, which is described as the abode of BRAHMĀ'S sons, SANAKA, SĀNANDA, SANĀTANA, and SANATKUMĀRA; above this, is the fifth world [Page724] or the {%Tapoloka%}, where the deities called {%Vairāgis%} reside; the seventh world, {%Satyaloka%} {%or Brahmaloka%}, is the abode of BRAHMĀ, and translation to this world exempts beings from further birth; the three first worlds are destroyed at the end of each {%Kalpa%} or day of BRAHMĀ; the three last at the end of his life, or of 100 of his years; the fourth {%Loka%} is equally permanent, but is uninhabitable from heat, at the time the three first are burning: another enumeration calls these seven worlds, earth, sky, heaven, middle region, place of births, mansion of the blest, and abode of truth, placing the sons of BRAHMĀ in the sixth division, and stating the fifth or {%Janaloka%} to be that, where animals destroyed in the general conflagration are born again.
.²3 Sight, seeing.
.²4 An element, a primary or radical part of being.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#loka#} to see, <ab>aff.</ab> {#Ga#}.

<lex>mf.</lex> ({#-viH-vI#})
.²1 A bird.
.²2 The eye.
.²3 Heaven.
.²4 The region of the wind.
<lex>ind.</lex>
A particle and prefix, implying:
.²1 Certainty, ascertainment, as {#vivektuM#} to determine, to judge.
.²2 Separation, disjunction, as {#viyoktu#} to disjoin.
.²3 Aversion, repugnance, as {#virodDu#} to oppose.
.²4 Impatience, intolerance, as {#vinfzwaM#} to be impatient.
.²5 Variety, difference, {#viSezwu#} to distinguish.
.²6 Cause, motive, {#viGAtuM#} to prescribe or order.
.²7 Motion, progress, {#vicarituM#} to go.
.²8 Privation, {#viRItuM#} to take away. It generally corresponds to the {%English%} adjuncts, {%a, ex, de, dis, in, un%}, <ab>&c.</ab> and is frequently an expletive.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#vA#} to go, Uṇādi <ab>aff.</ab> {#in#} with the effect of {#qit#} or {#qa#}, which ejects the final syllable.
<LEND>

<lex>mfn.</lex> ({#-SvaH-SvA-SvaM#})
All, entire, whole, universal.
<lex>n.</lex> ({#-SvaM#})
The world, the universe.
<lex>m.</lex> ({#-SvaH#})
A deity of a particular class in which ten are enumerated; their names are VASU, SATYA, KRATU, DAKṢA, KĀLA, KĀMA, DHṚTI, KURU, PURURĀVAN, and MADRAVA: They are worshipped particularly at the funeral obsequies in honor of deceased progenitors in general, and receive an oblation of clarified butter at the daily and domestic {%Śrāddha%}.
<lex>nf.</lex> ({#-SvaM-SvA#})
Dry ginger.
<lex>f.</lex> ({#-SvA#})
A tree, the bark of which is said to be used in dying red, commonly {%Atis%}, (<bot>Betula</bot>.)
<ab>E.</ab>
{#viSa#} to enter, to pervade, Uṇādi <ab>aff.</ab> {#kan#}.
<LEND>

<L>37707<pc>830<k1>Sama<k2>Sama

.²2 Quiet, tranquillity, rest, calm, (in general.)
.²3 Final happiness, emancipation from human existence.
.²4 Cure, convalescence, alleviation of pain or disease.
.²5 Abuse, imprecation, malediction.
.²6 The hand.

<L>39141<pc>862<k1>SrAdDa<k2>SrAdDa
{#SrAdDa#}¦
<lex>mfn.</lex> ({#-dDaH-dDA-dDaM#})
Faithful, believing.
<lex>n.</lex> ({#-dDaM#})
A funeral {{cermony observed->ceremony observed||20210731|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66|}} at various fixed periods and for different purposes, consisting of offerings with water and fire to the gods and manes, and gifts and food to the relations present and assisting {%Brahmans%}; it is especially performed for a parent recently deceased, or for three paternal ancestors, or for all ancestors collectively, and is supposed necessary to secure the ascent and residence of the souls of the deceased in a world appropriated to the manes. The following distributions of this ceremony are specified; the {#pArvvaRaM#} in honor of three ancestors, {#ekoddizwaM#} of one, {#nityaM#} regular, {#nEmittikaM#} occasionally, {#kAmyaM#} for the attainment of some particular object, {#AhnikaM#} daily, {#vfdDiH#} for the obtaining of increase of prosperity, and {#sapiRqanaM#} in which the balls of meat offered to the deceased individually and collectively are blended together. There are many other kinds: those for a person recently deceased are one on the day after mourning expires, and twelve others in twelve successive months; one at the end of the third fortnight, one in the sixth month, and one in the twelfth, concluding with a {%Sapiṇḍana%}, on the anniversary of the person's death; in general they are all performed in the course of the two or three first days, and the {%Śrāddha%} for the deceased is only annually repeated. There is also a sort of {%Śrāddha%} performed daily during the days of mourning, usually ten, on which a funeral cake is presented, increasing one or more each day till ten cakes are offered.
<ab>E.</ab>
{#SradDA#} faith, {#aR#} or {#Ra#} <ab>aff.</ab> of possession or relation, as the abandonment or presentation of meat, <ab>&c.</ab> through faith of its efficacy, in behalf of the souls of the deceased.
<LEND>
